directions.name: Warm Direct Couplet
directions.refrain:
Ker skrbite zame,
rada imam prav vas same.
directions.approach: A tender two-line declaration with a clear, warmly emphatic rhyme.
directions.genderDependency: The mushroom narrator is feminine, requiring »rada«.

directions.name: All Together Hook
directions.refrain: Vsi, prav vsi — pazite name, pri srcu ste mi!
directions.approach: A playful collective pickup followed by two compact, rhythmic phrases.

directions.name: Tender Flowing Refrain
directions.refrain: Rada vas imam, za vašo skrb vam hvalo dam.
directions.approach: A flowing love-first refrain balanced by a concise expression of gratitude.
directions.genderDependency: The mushroom narrator is feminine, requiring »rada«.
